actions.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational photorealistic rehabilitation exercise photo, identity-preserve reposing.
Input images 1–3 are strict identity, clothing, photographic style and background-color references of the SAME woman. Repose that exact woman only. Keep her same face and age, East Asian features, natural skin texture, dark ponytail, fitted plain white short-sleeve crewneck T-shirt and dark charcoal full-length athletic trousers. Preserve EXACT cool light gray-blue seamless studio background hue from the references, continuous same-color floor, soft diffused neutral studio light and realistic photographic texture. Normal adult anatomy and proportions, natural head-to-body ratio and equal normal leg lengths, no distortion. Unbranded white low-profile athletic shoes as used in preceding standing exercise images.
Specific action: 101 / T-LOW-026 / 低台阶上台阶：扶稳至持哑铃. Show the BASIC UNWEIGHTED supported STEP-UP, final stable arrival phase, not toe-tapping from ground. One sturdy rectangular low gray rehabilitation step about 12 cm high with nonslip top. Woman facing image right, useful near-side three-quarter side view. Leading foot is entirely planted on the step; leading knee and hip extended comfortably to lift the whole body above the step. The other foot has JUST FOLLOWED and lightly touches the same step top with its toe, heel slightly elevated, knees almost extended. Neither foot is on the ground at this instant: both feet located on top of step, most weight on the leading flat foot. Torso upright, shoulders level, hips forward over supported leg, relaxed head. One hand lightly grips a reliable long horizontal fixed support rail at waist height, rail attached by visible sturdy posts with flat wide bases next to step. Free arm relaxed. No dumbbells at this basic phase. Stable controlled posture, no jumping, no exaggerated high stair.
Composition: one woman, one phase, one independent portrait photograph 1122x1402, aspect ratio 4:5; entire head, hands, BOTH feet, full step and rail visible with margins, natural perspective without foreshortening or wide-angle lens, camera level at a suitable full-body height. Props understated neutral gray, background remains the original gray-blue studio. No text, numbers, logos, watermark, arrows, diagrams, inset, collage, ghosting, other people, extra limbs or fake anatomy.

Torso near upright with a small natural hip hinge, knees tracking foot direction, spine neutral, calm expression. One hand lightly holds a reliable horizontal fixed support rail attached to sturdy visible floor posts next to the step, other arm relaxed, no weights. Show unmistakable difference between the bent support foot on the step and the extended foot's heel gently on the lower floor. No jumping, no dropped pelvis or collapsed knee.
